meta.name: to-spec
meta.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理当前讨论为规格并发布到项目问题列表
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们经常在讨论后需要把共识沉淀成正式规格并同步到项目管理工具。
copy.tagline_en: Turn your discussion into a spec and post it to the issue tracker.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn meeting discussions into a formal spec and share it with your team.

howto.what: 把当前对话与代码库内容直接整理成一份规格说明(类似PRD),并发布到项目的issue跟踪系统;不会向你追问细节,只综合已有讨论。写作时会先用项目领域词汇,再按给定模板产出。
howto.when: 当你说「把这段讨论整理成 spec/PRD 发到 issue 系统」这类要求时触发;若 issue 跟踪与标签词汇尚未配置,它会提示先运行 /setup-matt-pocock-skills。

say.text: 把刚才讨论的内容整理成一份spec,发到项目issue跟踪器。
say.note: 将综合对话并执行发布流程。

say.text: 生成spec时把用户故事列全,再创建issue。
say.note: 用户故事会按模板详细展开。

say.text: 写spec前,先告诉我你选好的测试切入点在哪里。
say.note: Claude会先展示测试切入点再继续。

howto.what_en: Converts the conversation and codebase understanding into a spec (like a PRD) and publishes it to the issue tracker. No interview, it synthesizes what you've discussed, using the project's domain glossary and the given template.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to turn the current discussion into a spec/PRD and publish it to the issue tracker. Without preconfigured tracker/triage vocabulary, it asks you to run /setup-matt-pocock-skills.

say_en.text: Turn our discussion into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker.
For the spec, include a full list of user stories, then create the issue.
say_en.note: User stories will be listed extensively.

say_en.text: Before writing the spec, tell me where you plan to test.
say_en.note: Asks for your testing seam before continuing.
